newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA BOND MKT SEVEN-MO TURNOVER UP 16 PCT Y/Y.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA BOND MKT SEVEN-MO TURNOVER UP 16 PCT Y/Y.

text.p: Bond market turnover grew 16 percent to 2.34 trillion rand in the first seven months of this year -- some seven times market capitalisation of 320 billion rand, the Bond Exchange said on Thursday.
The increase came despite a 15 percent decline in reported trades to 233,490 matched trades, it said.
It said average daily trade volumes had also grown to 15.9 billion rand a day compared with 14.2 billion rand in the same period a year ago.
Turnover for the month of July was up 45 percent from a year ago at 441.85 billion rand as non-resident purchases grew four-fold to 55.44 billion rand.
Repurchase transactions totalled 49 percent of total trade in July -- down from 52 percent in June, the exchange said.
